name: emi
description: Emi - Only SDK generation tool for API you need, MCP server, AI Tool, JSON RPC, definition to Go, TypeScript, Kotlin, Swift, C++, C, PHP and many more.

paragraphs: Live playground: — try Emi in the browser, no install needed. Cookbook:

Emi is a code generator: you describe your API once — dtos, entities, actions, config — in a single yaml file, and Emi compiles that one definition into working, type-safe code for multiple languages, so the backend and every client SDK are always generated from the same source of truth and never drift out of sync with each other.

existing action with from:/intent: true — compiled into typed Go signatures ready to wire into an MCP server. An entity with intent: true exposes all of its generated actions at once (listBooks, getBook, createBook, updateBook, previewDeleteBooks, deleteBooks for a book entity).
features: A Go/Gin backend paired with a TypeScript web app, mobile (Swift/Kotlin), and desktop
A game (Unreal Engine) or embedded device (ESP-IDF/Arduino) talking to that backend
Publishing a multi-language SDK for your API.
Generating a CLI straight from the same action definitions the HTTP API exposes.
